patch_description:
The previous implementation failed validation because it could alter dataframe structure and row/value alignment during recursive reconstruction, merging, index handling, and final sorting. It also returned an empty column-ordering list, despite the API requiring valid per-row column orderings.

The replacement preserves every original row, cell, index, and dataframe shape. It normalizes values only for scoring, builds several bounded column-order candidates, measures real serialized Trie-prefix reuse using lexicographically adjacent LCPs, and returns the best candidate. It supports row-specific column orders, keeps merged column groups contiguous, respects one-way dependency precedence where possible, and avoids modifying stored values while constructing scoring strings.
